notes.title: NEW FEATURES AND BUG FIXES!
notes.notes:
Hi there! It's been 4 days since our launch and we're even more excited after seeing all your feedback :) So, we added a couple of new features and made some improvements for a better gameplay experience:
•	A stopwatch on the game screen for you to track your level time and best time!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30766576/eca45d1473878d9b00a62254a1d49ac2de72f6c3.jpg[/img]

•	Death count, current and best level times in the pause menu

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30766576/098f163733a15a48cb33a5524dc3292abde8d264.jpg[/img]

•	No alt-tab and alt-enter issues!
•	Better autosave to secure your level progress
•	Level balance improvements
•	And some more fixes ;)

notes.title: OUT ON MONDAY!
notes.notes:
It's not just about platformer skills anymore.
It's about losing directions.
It's about forgetting left and right.

It's about finding the other half of your body,
without being cut in half.

Get ready.
We are out on Feb 12th, 12pm Pacific Time.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30766576/0940d3390423f7b479ff123afe45d66917b2e2cc.gif[/img]
